summary: PTL Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Wai Hong Lin, effective August 31, 2026, for personal reasons with no disagreement, and the appointment of Chun Kit Yu as independent director effective September 1, 2026, with annual compensation of US$18,000. Yu was deemed independent under SEC and Nasdaq rules, and an audit committee financial expert. He will chair the Audit Committee and serve on Compensation and Nominating Committees. This routine director change is not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic implications are present. The filing is a standard corporate governance update.
